texts.preamble: Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
texts.facts: Challenge is to an order dated 08/03/2019 passed in Writ Petition No.2129/2017; whereby, the challenge to order dated 17/01/2017 passed by the District Supply Officer, Gwalior, cancelling the allotment of fair price shop No.161 Code No. 405120 has been negatived. The cancellation of allotment of fair price shop was on the findings of irregularities committed by the society in the distribution of essential commodities. The cancellation was questioned on merit as well as the propriety. As to propriety, it was the contention by the appellant that it was beyond jurisdiction of the District Supply Officer to have straight away cancelled the shop without first cancelling the fair price shop allotment authority letter. The contentions were negatived. Thus, the formal mode of allotment of fair price shop is by issuance of fair price shop allotment authority letter as defined under the Clause-2 (k) of 2015, Control Order. The impugned order Annexure P-2 has cancelled the said allotment letter. This is not a case that the work of fair price shop was attached without suspending the letter of authority. It is contended that learned Single Judge miscontrued the provisions contained in Control Order 16 of Control Order 2015 whereunder unless the fair price shop Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 May, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82559072/ 1 authority letter is cancelled, the fair price shop cannot be cancelled. The respondent, however, supports the impugned order. Madhya Pradesh Public Distribution System (Control) Order 2015 are framed by the State Government in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 3 read with Section 5 of the Essential Commodities Act, 1955 (10 of 1955) and in pursuance of S.O. 681 (E) and S.O. 682 (E) both dated 30th November, 1974 of Ministry of Industries and Civil Supplies (Department of Civil Supplies and Cooperation) and GSR 800 dated 9 th June, 1978 of Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation (Department of Food), for regulating the control of Targeted Public Distribution System in the State of Madhya Pradesh. Control Order 3 deals with the provision regarding Eligible Household; Control Orders 4 to 7 makes provision regarding issuance THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others of ration cards, validity, amendment and cancellation of ration card, responsibility of ration card holder and number and location of fair price shops, respectively. That the fair price shop allotment authority issues letter in prescribed Form-B which entitles the concerned institution to operate fair price shops as per clause 10 of the Control Order.
texts.arguments: "Pertinently the term allotment letter does not find mention in the definition clause of 2015, Control Order. Clause-8 relates to allotment of fair price shops to the THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others extent that Fair Price Shop Allotment Authority shall allot fair price shops only to such societies/groups as recognized by Scheduled-2 of 2015, Control Order. Clause (3) of Control Order 8 provides that, eligible institutions, interested in operation of fair price shop shall apply to the fair price shop allotment authority prescribed in Form-A. Control order 16, which we are presently concerned with, envisages:- "16. Punishment and Penalty.- (1) In case of contravention of any provision of Central / State order or this order, the fair price shop authority letter may be suspended or cancelled and security amount may be forfeited wholly or partially by shop allotment authority. In such case, forfeited amount shall be recoverable from guilty employee of concerning institution. (2) In case of violation under clause 13 for quantity more than 10 percent of the monthly allocation or repetition of violation under the same clause, a person shall mandatorily be prosecuted under section 7 of Essential Commodities Act, 1955 (No. 10 of 1955) THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others (3) In case of suspension of a fair price shop, the Fair price shop allotment authority shall issue show cause notice to the concerned fair price shop within 10 days and as far as possible, pass final order within three months. Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta ... vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 May, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82559072/ 2 (4) Fair price shop allotment authority, after giving reasonable opportunity to fair price shop to submit its representation in writing and following principle of natural justice, may cancel authority letter mentioning the reason thereof: Provided that, Fair price shop allotment authority shall not allot that fair price shop to any new society/institution till the final disposal of the appeal. (5) During suspension/ cancellation of a fair price shop, Fair price shop allotment authority shall make alternative arrangement from a nearby fair price shop to ensure distribution of commodities to card holders attached with such shop: Provided that, a fair price shop of rural area shall not be attached with a fair price shop in urban area and vice-versa. (6) If any essential commodity is diverted or distributed to any ineligible person by authorised agency/ fair price shop owner, the price thereof shall be recovered, from responsible salesperson/ employee/ person at the rate of prevailing market price or economic cost (after reducing cost price), whichever is higher. (7) Shop allotment authority may order, in writing, to institution to remove the salesperson of fair price shop, if found guilty, from duties of distribution of commodities of Public Distribution System. (9) If any action has been contemplated under the provisions of this order or Co-operative Act against THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others allottee Co-operative society by concerning Deputy Commissioner- cum- Sub Registrar/ assistant Commissioner -cum- Assistant Registrar, he shall immediately inform the Fair price shop allotment authority in writing." Control Order 16 empowers the fair price shop allotment authority to suspend or cancel and forfeit security amount wholly or partially in case of contravention of any provision of Central/ State THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others order or Control Order, 2015. Bare reading of Control Order 16 makes it clear that there are two prone actions that fair price shop authority can take under Control THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others Order 16, i.e., suspension or cancellation of fair price shop allotment letter or suspension or cancellation of fair price shop. In view whereof, the exercise of the power by District Supply Officer in canceling the shop allotted to the appellant cannot be found to be beyond jurisdiction as is being contended on behalf of the THE HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Manisha Mahila Prathmik Upbhokta Sahakari Bhandar Maryadit Vs. State of M.P. and others appellant.
